# awscc_sagemaker_cluster_scheduler_config (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::ClusterSchedulerConfig. Cluster policy configuration used for task prioritization and fair-share allocation of idle compute.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_arn` (String) ARN of the cluster.
- `name` (String) Name for the cluster policy.
- `scheduler_config` (Attributes) Cluster policy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduler_config))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the cluster policy.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags of the cluster policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `cluster_scheduler_config_arn` (String) ARN of the cluster policy.
- `cluster_scheduler_config_id` (String) ID of the cluster policy.
- `cluster_scheduler_config_version` (Number) Version of the cluster policy.
- `creation_time` (String) Creation time of the cluster policy.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) Status of the cluster policy.

<a id="nestedatt--scheduler_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scheduler_config`

Optional:

- `fair_share` (String) When enabled, entities borrow idle compute based on assigned FairShareWeight.
- `idle_resource_sharing` (String) Configuration for sharing idle compute resources across entities.
- `priority_classes` (Attributes List) List of priority class configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduler_config--priority_classes))

<a id="nestedatt--scheduler_config--priority_classes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scheduler_config.priority_classes`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the priority class.
- `weight` (Number) Weight of the priority class. Range 0-100, default 0.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_cluster_scheduler_config.example
  identity = {
    cluster_scheduler_config_arn = "cluster_scheduler_config_arn"
  }
}
```
